standard_prerequisites.name: Representation of F
standard_prerequisites.use: X constructed as the union of the U_d representing F_d, with affine identifications.

standard_prerequisites.name: Twisted algebra on relative Proj
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies psi: pi^*A to the direct sum of the O_Y(n) agreeing with global sections over affine opens.

core_obligations: First argument: over each affine open of S both X and Y identify with the homogeneous spectrum of the sections of A, compatibly with restriction; glue the identifications.

Second argument: psi locally gives quadruples, hence an element of F(Y); the representing property gives a canonical morphism Y to X over S; by canonicity work locally on S, where the identification is clear.
proof_roadmap: Run the affine identification and glue it, or push the universal quadruple through the representing property and reduce the isomorphism check to affine opens.
difficulty_reason: Two complete arguments: an affine-local identification of the two representing schemes, and a canonical universal-family construction reducing the isomorphism check to the affine case; the first argument compresses its final glueing step.
